sourceOfTruth: GitHub issue #70 + owner instruction in ChatGPT on 2026-08-07
changeClass: reversible production content cleanup after backup gate
preflight: Resolve the existing WordPress page by slug 'senzory' and record its ID, status, author, modified time and native builder/editor type.
Export the page raw content plus all builder/template/postmeta fields needed for an exact restore.
Create and verify a fresh full database backup and wp-content backup; record SHA-256 hashes in rollback-manifest.json.
Capture current public HTML and desktop/mobile screenshots.
Do not change WooCommerce products, prices, stock, categories or global theme settings in this task.

safeEdits.details: Remove any public editorial/staging instruction beginning with 'Pred zverejnením:' or equivalent internal publishing note. Do not replace it with another staging note.
Remove public placeholder wording such as 'Overená fotka sa dopĺňa'. Keep the layout accessible; do not claim that an image is verified unless its source is actually verified.

Correct strings such as 'produktov? poh?ad', 'vodotesn?', 'pohybov?' only if the authenticated raw WordPress content itself contains broken characters. If raw UTF-8 is correct and the corruption exists only in an external crawler/cache snapshot, do not rewrite the page for that reason.

For every product card on /senzory/, keep price, stock wording and cart/detail CTA only when it resolves to a real current WooCommerce product and current store data. If a card is only a prototype or unresolved item, remove/disable the transactional claim without deleting the surrounding educational category content.
Keep the page as a KomArena sensor/ESPHome/Home Assistant content surface. Do not redirect it to ReSmart and do not delete it.

verification: Exactly one H1 remains and the page retains KomArena/Home Assistant/ESPHome sensor positioning.
Zero occurrences of 'Pred zverejnením' and zero public image-verification placeholder copy.
No newly introduced mojibake or replacement-question-mark corruption in visible Slovak text or alt text.
Every visible transactional CTA points to a real current target; no dead or prototype cart/detail CTA remains.
Desktop and mobile have no horizontal overflow or broken cards.
Compare public HTML after cache purge only for this page.
rollback: Restore the exact exported page content and native builder/postmeta snapshot.
Restore affected database rows from the verified backup if native page restore is insufficient.
Purge cache only for /senzory/ and verify the restored public snapshot.
forbidden: No blind direct REST overwrite of builder-managed content.
No global cache purge unless technically required and documented.
No product/price/stock edits without separate verified WooCommerce evidence.
Never log or commit WordPress credentials.
